Cenovus Energy Inc. | Senior Software Engineer | Full‑Time | ONSITE | Calgary, Alberta, Canada | Relocation Support | https://cenovus.wd3.myworkdayjobs.com/careers/job/CA-AB-Calg...?

We are hiring experienced Software Engineers to help accelerate delivery of AI solutions at our Energy company. We're looking for full-stack experience, multi-agent workflows, context engineering, agentic development.

Proficiency in Python, Ruby, SQL, JavaScript, frameworks (Rails, Django, Flask/Dash, etc.), AI (OpenAI API, Agno, LangChain, vector stores, RAG pipelines, etc.).

Full ownership of end‑to‑end systems - from problem framing through production - working directly with the team, and our stakeholders across the business on problems that matter.

Reach out through link in bio or apply through the link. No recruiters please.
